title: Exploitation of CVE-2024-35250 via Kernel Streaming IOCTL Requests
id: 2c0a4e53-c770-4cfe-8811-aad2fe76d284
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of IOCTL_KS_PROPERTY with KSPROPERTY_TYPE_UNSERIALIZESET and KSPROPSETID_DrmAudioStream to exploit CVE-2024-35250 in kernel streaming drivers, indicating potential initial access or privilege escalation.
references:
    - https://thehackernews.com/2024/12/cisa-and-fbi-raise-alerts-on-exploited.html

    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1211/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-10-03
tags:
    - attack.privilege-escalation
    - attack.t1068
    - attack.defense-evasion
    - attack.t1211
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'IOCTL_KS_PROPERTY'
            - 'KSPROPERTY_TYPE_UNSERIALIZESET'
            - 'KSPROPSETID_DrmAudioStream'
        Image|endswith:
            - '\mskssrv.exe'
            - '\ks.sys'
            - '\ksthunk.sys'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative tools using kernel streaming APIs
    - Debugging or development environments interacting with kernel drivers
level: high

description: Detects the initial access phase where a user clicks on a hyperlink in a phishing email that leads to the download of a 7z file containing the NetWire RAT. This rule targets the specific download URL mentioned in the threat intelligence.

title: Initial Access via CVE-2023-22518 Confluence Auth Bypass
id: 7a9c7e6d-4f2a-4b3c-9d8e-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: |
    Detects exploitation of CVE-2023-22518 in Confluence Data Center and Server by sending a POST request to /json/setup-restore.action with X-Atlassian-Token header set to 'no-check' and multipart/form-data payload. This indicates an unauthenticated attacker attempting to bypass authentication and gain administrative access.
references:
    - https://confluence.atlassian.com/security/cve-2023-22518-improper-authorization-vulnerability-in-confluence-data-center-and-server-1311473907.html
    - https://www.huntress.com/blog/confluence-to-cerber-exploitation-of-cve-2023-22518-for-ransomware-deployment
    - https://github.com/ForceFledgling/CVE-2023-22518
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1190/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1548/002/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-10-03
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.privilege-escalation
    - attack.t1190
    - attack.t1548.002
logsource:
    category: webserver
detection:
    selection1:
        cs-method: 'POST'
        cs-uri-stem|contains: '/json/setup-restore'
    selection2:
        cs-header|contains: 'X-Atlassian-Token: no-check'
    selection3:
        cs-header|contains: 'multipart/form-data'
    condition: all of selection*
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative scripts using the same endpoint for legitimate setup tasks
level: high

title: MERCURY APT Activity
rules_yaml:
title: Initial Access via Log4Shell Exploitation of SysAid Server
id: 5a7d8e9f-1b2c-4d3e-5f6a-7b8c9d0e1f2a
status: experimental
description: Detects exploitation of Log4j 2 vulnerabilities in SysAid Server via unauthenticated HTTP requests containing Log4Shell LDAP JNDI payload, indicating initial access attempt.
references:
    - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/08/25/mercury-leveraging-log4j-2-vulnerabilities-in-unpatched-systems-to-target-israeli-organizations/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1190/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-10-03
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.t1190
logsource:
    category: webserver
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        request_body|contains:
            - '${jndi:ldap://'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate applications using LDAP JNDI lookups for legitimate purposes
level: high

title: PowerShell Execution with Bypass and Encoded Commands
id: 6b8c9d0e-2f1a-3e4b-5c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell execution with encoded commands and bypass flags, as used by MERCURY for reconnaissance and lateral movement.
references:
    - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/08/25/mercury-leveraging-log4j-2-vulnerabilities-in-unpatched-systems-to-target-israeli-organizations/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-10-03
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.001
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '-exec bypass'
            - '-w 1 -enc'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative scripts using PowerShell with similar flags
level: high

title: Persistence via SysAidServer Child Processes and Registry Keys
id: 7c8d9e0f-3a1b-4c2d-5e6f-7a8b9c0d1e2f
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious child processes of SysAidServer and potential registry run key modifications indicating persistence.
references:
    - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/08/25/mercury-leveraging-log4j-2-vulnerabilities-in-unpatched-systems-to-target-israeli-organizations/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1547/001/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-10-03
tags:
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1547.001
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '\java.exe'
            - '\javaw.exe'
        ParentCommandLine|contains: SysAidServer
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate Java applications using SysAidServer as parent process
level: medium

title: Credential Access via Mimikatz Execution
id: 8d9e0f1a-4b2c-5d3e-6f7a-8b9c0d1e2f3a
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of Mimikatz, a tool used for credential dumping from LSASS memory.
references:
    - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/08/25/mercury-leveraging-log4j-2-vulnerabilities-in-unpatched-systems-to-target-israeli-organizations/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/001/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-10-03
tags:
    - attack.credential-access
    - attack.t1003.001
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\mimikatz.exe'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate security tools using Mimikatz for authorized testing
level: high

title: Lateral Movement via Remcom and Encoded PowerShell Scripts
id: 9e0f1a2b-5c3d-6e4f-7a8b-9c0d1e2f3a4b
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of Remcom tool and encoded PowerShell scripts used for lateral movement by MERCURY.
references:
    - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/08/25/mercury-leveraging-log4j-2-vulnerabilities-in-unpatched-systems-to-target-israeli-organizations/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1021/001/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-10-03
tags:
    - attack.lateral-movement
    - attack.t1021.001
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\Remcom.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'UwB0AGEAcgB0AC0ASgBvAGIAIAAtAFMAYwByAGkAcAB0AEIAbABvAGMAawAgAHsAKABzAGEAcABzACAAKAAiAHAA'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate tools using similar command-line patterns
level: high

title: Reconnaissance Commands Executed by MERCURY
id: a0f1a2b3-6c4d-7e5f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b
status: experimental
description: Detects common reconnaissance commands executed by MERCURY for system discovery and enumeration.
references:
    - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/08/25/mercury-leveraging-log4j-2-vulnerabilities-in-unpatched-systems-to-target-israeli-organizations/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1087/001/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-10-03
tags:
    - attack.discovery
    - attack.t1087.001
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'whoami'
            - 'hostname'
            - 'ipconfig /all'
            - 'net user'
            - 'quser'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative scripts performing system discovery
level: medium

status: experimental
description: Detects exploitation attempts of CVE-2021-26084 in Atlassian Confluence Server/Data Center via unauthenticated OGNL injection using the createpage-entervariables.action endpoint with malicious query parameters.
references:
    - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2021-26084

    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1190/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/007/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-10-03
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.t1190
    - attack.t1059.007
logsource:
    category: webserver
detection:
    selection:
        cs-uri-query|contains:
            - 'createpage-entervariables.action'
            - '\$\{'
            - 'SpaceKey='
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative use of the createpage endpoint with valid parameters
level: high

level: high
